notes.content: [p]Just a minor patch, folks. Like changin' the bobber, not the bait.[/p][list][*][p]Updated Humpback Whitefish spawns to reliably spawn S and M sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera toggle button for gamepad (L3) and keyboard (C)[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary fish will spawn again after a day (20hrs real time)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chance larger fish will eat the fish on your hook[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "catch fish with a fish" completing when it shouldn't[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed edge case where "catch fish above water" achievements wouldn't complete[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Fish Fighting Update
notes.content:
[p]Howdy folks, and thanks for playing! Since launch, we’ve been reading your feedback and working hard on an update focused on refining the fish fighting mechanics and adding some fun new features.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎣 Fish Fighting Improvements[/b][/h3][p]You can now let your line go slack and see it with clear visual cues to help you manage tension and avoid over-pulling. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/b2f6ba4d4f79b2cf50a96b763839a30093467388.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also added the ability to steer and guide the fish slightly when pulling at just the right time and improved bubble particles to let you know when the fish is thrashing easier.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐟 Smarter Fish Behaviour[/b][/h3][p] Fish no longer sprint endlessly in one direction or head butt the lakebed. Their movement is now more natural and satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧍 New Angler Animations[/b][/h3][p]
We’ve added some lovely new animations to bring your angler to life with more personality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/2286b847e880c04b86c485fbe55f915bd94618d2.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]⚙️ Idle Mode Enhancements[/b][/h3][p]
You can now tweak Idle Mode to limit what can be caught passively.
And introducing [b]Screensaver Mode[/b] – no progression, no sales, no achievements. Just relax and enjoy the scenery.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐶 New Pupper Option[/b][/h3][p]
There’s a new good doggo to choose from: a loyal German Shepherd companion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/e5b4749c1ed18667c6e288e320140d833056549d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you to everyone who helped Beta test this update! [/h3]

notes.title: Cast n Chill Demo v2 is Live
notes.content:
Hey there folks,

A big thank you to everyone who filled out our feedback form or dropped suggestions in the Steam forums, your thoughts have been incredibly helpful in shaping this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/f9167243fbc2d39251b258a532277f94940e909b.png[/img]

We’ve just released a new version of the Cast n Chill demo packed with features you asked for. Whether it was improving fishing mechanics, adding new content, or making the game even more relaxing to play, we’ve listened, and here’s what’s new:

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]  [b]Fawnmirror Lake[/b] – A tranquil new location to explore, unlocked via fishing license
[*]  [b]5 New Fish, 1 New Rod, 5 New Lures[/b] – Expand your gear and discover new species to catch
[*]  [b]Idle Mode[/b] – Let the game cast for you while you chill and enjoy a calming, passive experience
[*]  [b]Vertical Mode[/b] – Resize the window to sit neatly on the side of your screen
[*]  [b]Zoom Out Option[/b] – Get a taller view of the stunning landscapes and soak in more scenery
[*]  [b]Refined Fishing Mechanics[/b] – Improved line controls and a new lure system linking lures to rods
[*]  [b]Fish Battle Balancing[/b] – Reeling in fish now feels more responsive and rewarding (the fish get tired!)
[*]  [b]Nibbles[/b] – Fish may nibble without biting, use the right lure to hook the species you’re after
[*]  [b]Fish Discovery & Logbook[/b] – Find new fish to unlock their details in your logbook and research the best lure to use
[*]  [b]Character Customiser [/b]– Shuffle your look with a randomiser (full customisation coming soon)
[*]  [b]New Music & Soundscapes[/b] – Tranquil new music and improved natural soundscapes to deepen your relaxation
[/list]

This update is a big step toward the cozy fishing experience we’ve all been imagining, and it wouldn’t be possible without your feedback. If you get a chance to try the demo again, we’d love to hear what you think!

Thanks for being part of the journey,
 - Team Wombat Brawler
